feeds.title: Lex Levinrad Blog
feeds.description: Lex Levinrad is a real estate investor, national speaker, and author and teaches new real estate investors how to wholesale, fix and flip real estate. Follow this blog to learn how to wholesale real estate, and how to buy, fix, and flip houses.

feeds.title: Flipping The Flip
feeds.description: A DIY home improvement story of undoing everything a house flipper did. Topics covered are DIY, crafts, home decor, interior design, home improvement, and recipes. Authored by Becky, a DIY'er and a do-er of things.

feeds.title: Invest Four More Blog
feeds.description: Find our most recent articles on real estate investing including house flipping, rental properties, being a real estate agent, and much more! 'Invest Four More' offers advice, education, books, videos, and case studies on hundreds of real estate deals. Authored by Mark Ferguson, a Real Estate Investor.

feeds.title: Spruce & Pine Blog
feeds.description: Spruce and Pine find homes with a soul that's been buried by the years, bring them back to life, and curate odd delights along the way. Some call it flipping homes. We call it flipping fantastic.

feeds.title: Mostess Blog
feeds.description: I'm FlippinWendy. I started as a house flipper in Cincinnati, Ohio. FlippinWendy Design was born as a renovation obsessed biz specializing in floor plan revisions and designing a touch outside the norm.

feeds.title: WorthFlipping.House Blog
feeds.description: At Worth Flipping House, our commitment goes beyond just creating software. We understand the challenges faced by house flippers, investors, and teams, and we're dedicated to providing an intuitive, user-friendly solution that simplifies complex processes. We stand as a bridge between the world of real estate and cutting-edge technology, enabling seamless communication, informed decision-making, and maximum efficiency.

feeds.title: REI/kit News
feeds.description: REI/kit House Flipping Software is an integrated system for professional deal analysis, premium comps & ARV, estimating rehab costs, a CRM for lead management, and investor websites for lead marketing.

feeds.title: Flipping Dallas
feeds.description: Flipping Dallas has been flipping houses in the Seattle area for over 13 years now and our specialty is taking the most undesirable homes on the block and making them the most desirable. We strive to stay on top of our flips by catering to what people want to see with quality finish work.

feeds.title: Copper Dot Interiors Blog
feeds.description: Copper Dot Interiors blog inspires and empowers you to embrace design and make your home the best it can be! Author Karen Goodman strives to provide design, inspiration, renovation realities, and the occasional DIY to allow you to embrace your space.

feeds.title: 7 Figure Flipping
feeds.description: 10X Your House Flipping or Wholesaling Business Do more deals. Make more money. Work fewer hours. Get your life back! 7 Figure Flipping is the #1 resource for serious investors who want to build thriving, consistent, profitable businesses flipping and wholesaling houses.

feeds.title: Anchor Loans Blog
feeds.description: Anchor Loans is the nation's largest fix-and-flip lending company. We bring borrowers and investors together to create mutually beneficial opportunities for all three parties. We provide quick approval, flexible programs, competitive rates, and reliable service.

feeds.title: House Flipping Guide
feeds.description: Gerald Harris has dedicated his life to serving investors and other professionals. He runs House Flipping Guide, the last and only real estate investment platform you will ever need. He will assist you in setting your goals and figure out what you want to accomplish and will guide you the rest of the way, showing you what it takes to succeed as a real estate investor.
